.k5-product-entry .k5-table td{padding-inline:4px;vertical-align:top}
.k5-product-entry .k5-picker-list{position:static;inset:auto!important;max-height:235px!important;width:100%;margin-block-start:4px}
.k5-product-entry .k5-table td>input{width:100%}
.k5-picker-list button{display:flex;gap:5px;justify-content:space-between;width:100%;padding:5px;border:0;border-radius:4px;background:white;text-align:right;cursor:pointer;font:inherit;color:#19362e}
.k5-picker-list button:hover,.k5-picker-list .k5-picker-active{background:#e1f1e9}
.k5-picker-list small{display:flex;gap:6px;flex-wrap:wrap}
.k5-picker-list strong{white-space:normal;overflow-wrap:anywhere}
.k5-invoice-totals{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:12px;flex-wrap:wrap;padding:8px;background:#ecf6ef;border-radius:8px;font-size:13px}
.k5-invoice-totals bdi{font-weight:700}
.k5-invoice-totals>span,.k5-invoice-totals>strong{display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:5px;min-width:105px;padding:5px}
.k5-invoice-totals bdi{display:block;text-align:right}
.k5-view-actions{margin-bottom:9px}
.k5-view-sheet{background:#edf3ef;border:1px solid #dfeae3;border-radius:7px;padding:10px;overflow:auto}
.k5-view-sheet .k5-paper{width:136mm;color:#111;display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:3mm;font-family:Arial,Tahoma,sans-serif;font-size:9pt;line-height:1.4}
.k5-paper,.k5-paper *{color:#111!important}
.k5-paper-header{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:flex-start;padding-bottom:3mm;border-bottom:1px solid #111;gap:5mm}
.k5-paper-brand-block{flex:0 1 62mm;min-width:0;text-align:right}
.k5-paper-logo{display:block;width:62mm;max-width:100%;height:auto;filter:grayscale(1);-webkit-filter:grayscale(1)}
.k5-paper-company{margin-top:2mm;text-align:right;font-size:10pt}
.k5-paper-heading{flex:0 1 62mm;min-width:0;text-align:left}
.k5-paper-header h2{font-size:15pt;margin:0 0 2mm;color:#111}
.k5-paper-heading bdi{font-size:9pt;white-space:nowrap}
.k5-paper-contact{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1.2fr 1fr;gap:2mm 5mm;direction:rtl;text-align:right;padding:1mm 0}
.k5-paper-contact>div:last-child{grid-column:1/-1}
.k5-paper-table{width:100%;border-collapse:collapse;table-layout:fixed;text-align:center;font-size:8pt;line-height:1.4;color:#111}
.k5-paper-table th,.k5-paper-table td{border:.5px solid #888;padding:1.7mm .8mm;overflow-wrap:anywhere;vertical-align:middle}
.k5-paper-table th{background:#f2f2f2;color:#111;font-weight:bold}
.k5-paper-table th:first-child{width:4%}
.k5-paper-table th:nth-child(2){width:26%}
.k5-paper-table th:nth-child(3){width:8%}
.k5-paper-table th:nth-child(4),.k5-paper-table th:nth-child(5){width:6%}
.k5-paper-table td:nth-child(2){text-align:right;font-weight:600}
.k5-paper-table td:not(:nth-child(2)){font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums}
.k5-paper-currency{text-align:right;font-size:8pt;color:#333;margin-top:-1mm}
.k5-inline-return{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(2,minmax(0,1fr));gap:10px;padding:12px;background:#fff9f5;border:1px solid #ead6ca;border-radius:9px}
.k5-inline-return>strong{grid-column:1/-1}
.k5-inline-return .k5-table input[type=checkbox]{width:16px;height:16px;accent-color:var(--k5-green)}
.k5-paper-returns{display:grid;gap:1.3mm;padding:2mm;background:white;border:.5px solid #888;border-radius:0;color:#111}
.k5-paper-returns h3{margin:0;font-size:10pt;color:#111}
.k5-paper-return-ref{font-size:8pt;color:#333}
.k5-returns-table th{background:#f2f2f2;color:#111}
.k5-returns-table th:not(:first-child),.k5-returns-table td:not(:first-child){text-align:center;font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums}
.k5-returns-table th:first-child{width:34%}
.k5-returns-table th:nth-child(2){width:12%}
.k5-returns-table th:nth-child(n+3){width:18%}
.k5-paper-footer{display:grid;gap:2mm;margin-top:2mm;white-space:pre-wrap;color:#111}
.k5-paper-totals{width:min(100%,72mm);margin-right:auto;margin-left:0}
.k5-paper-totals>div{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:center;gap:3mm;border-bottom:.5px solid #aaa;padding:1.4mm .8mm}
.k5-paper-totals>div:has(+.k5-paper-grand){border-bottom:0}
.k5-paper-totals>.k5-paper-grand{background:white;color:#111;font-weight:bold;font-size:11pt;border-top:1px solid #111;border-bottom:1px solid #111;padding:2.2mm .8mm;margin-top:.8mm}
.k5-paper-grand bdi{display:block;max-width:100%;overflow-wrap:anywhere}
.k5-paper-note{text-align:right}
.k5-paper-thanks{text-align:center;border-top:.5px solid #aaa;padding-top:2mm;margin-top:4mm;font-size:9pt}
#kab5-print-root{position:absolute;left:-20000px;top:0;width:148mm;height:209mm;padding:6mm;overflow:hidden;background:white}
#kab5-print-root .k5-paper{transform-origin:top right}
@page{size:A5 portrait;margin:0}
@media print{
 body.k5-printing{margin:0!important;padding:0!important;background:white!important;width:148mm!important;height:209mm!important;overflow:hidden!important}
 body.k5-printing>*:not(#kab5-print-root){display:none!important}
 body.k5-printing #kab5-print-root{position:absolute!important;inset:0 auto auto 0!important;display:block!important;overflow:hidden!important;width:148mm!important;height:209mm!important;print-color-adjust:exact;-webkit-print-color-adjust:exact}
}
@media(max-width:870px){.k5-app{grid-template-columns:164px minmax(0,1fr)}.k5-sidebar{padding:16px 8px}.k5-main{padding:13px 10px 70px}.k5-metric strong{font-size:19px}.k5-line{min-width:625px}.k5-lines{overflow-x:auto}.k5-dialog{max-height:97vh}}
@media(max-width:560px){.k5-app{display:block}.k5-sidebar{position:static;height:auto;gap:5px}.k5-sidebar nav{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap}.k5-sidebar nav button{font-size:12px;padding:6px}.k5-company{margin-top:0}.k5-metrics{grid-template-columns:1fr}.k5-form{grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr)}}
.k5-date-field{display:flex;align-items:stretch;gap:6px}
.k5-date-field>input{flex:1;min-width:0}
.k5-calendar{position:relative;display:grid;place-items:center;min-width:36px;border:1px solid #cedbd4;border-radius:6px;background:#fff}
.k5-calendar input{position:absolute;inset:0;width:100%;height:100%;opacity:0;cursor:pointer}
.k5-calendar:focus-within{outline:2px solid #539d7d}

  const hasExchange = doc => doc?.kind === "sale_return" && (doc.replacementLines?.length || doc.source?.replacementLines?.length);
  const records = [...state.docs, ...(state.deletedDocs || []).map(item => item.doc), ...(state.history || []).map(item => item.before)];
  if (!records.some(hasExchange)) return state;
  const removed = new Set(records.filter(doc => hasExchange(doc) && doc.source?.isReturn === false).map(doc => doc.id));
  function clean(doc) {
    if (!hasExchange(doc)) return doc;
    const {replacementLines, replacementTotal, ...rest} = doc;
    const {replacementLines: oldLines, isReturn, ...source} = doc.source || {};
    return {...rest, source, entries: replacementTotal ? rest.entries.slice(0, -2) : rest.entries};
  }
  return {...state, docs: state.docs.filter(doc => !removed.has(doc.id) || doc.source?.isReturn !== false).map(clean),
    deletedDocs: (state.deletedDocs || []).filter(item => item.doc.source?.isReturn !== false || !hasExchange(item.doc)).map(item => ({...item, doc: clean(item.doc)})),
    history: (state.history || []).filter(item => item.before?.source?.isReturn !== false || !hasExchange(item.before)).map(item => ({...item, before: clean(item.before)})),
    audit: state.audit.filter(item => !removed.has(item.ref) || state.docs.some(doc => doc.id === item.ref && doc.source?.isReturn !== false))};
}

function gd(state) {
  kabLegacyValidate(state);
  if (state.deletedDocs != null && !Array.isArray(state.deletedDocs)) {
    throw Error("قائمة المستندات المحذوفة غير صالحة.");
  }
  const documents = [...state.docs, ...(state.deletedDocs || []).map(record => record?.doc)];
  for (const doc of documents) {
    if (!doc || typeof doc.date !== "string" || !/^\d{4}-\d{2}-\d{2}$/.test(doc.date)) {
      throw Error("يوجد مستند بتاريخ غير صالح في ملف البيانات.");
    }
    Ql(doc.date);
    if (typeof doc.number !== "string" || !doc.number.trim() || typeof doc.kind !== "string"
      || !Number.isSafeInteger(doc.total) || doc.total < 0
      || !Array.isArray(doc.lines) || doc.lines.some(line => !line || typeof line !== "object")) {
      throw Error("يوجد مستند غير مكتمل أو مبلغ غير صالح في ملف البيانات.");
    }
  }
}

function kabDigits(value) {
  return String(value ?? "").replace(/[٠-٩۰-۹]/g, digit => {
    const point = digit.charCodeAt(0);
    return String(point >= 0x6f0 ? point - 0x6f0 : point - 0x660);
  });
}

function kabMoney(value, label = "المبلغ") {
  const text = kabDigits(value).trim().replace(/٬/g, ",").replace(/[\u00a0\u202f]/g, " ");
  if (text === "") return 0;
  const plain = /^\d+$/.test(text);
  const grouped = /^\d{1,3}([,. ])\d{3}(?:\1\d{3})*$/.test(text);
  if (!plain && !grouped) throw Error(label + " غير صالح. اكتب مبلغاً مثل 18,500.");
  const amount = Number(text.replace(/[,. ]/g, ""));
  if (!Number.isSafeInteger(amount) || amount > 1e12) throw Error(label + " خارج المجال المسموح.");
  return amount;
}

function kabPercent(value) {
  const text = kabDigits(value).trim().replace(/[٫,]/g, ".");
  if (!text) return 0;
  if (!/^\d+(?:\.\d{1,2})?$/.test(text) || Number(text) > 100) {
    throw Error("أدخل نسبة من 0 إلى 100.");
  }
  return Number(text);
}

function kabDisplayDate(date) {
  const parts = String(date || "").split("-");
  return parts.length === 3 ? [parts[2], parts[1], parts[0]].join("/") : String(date || "");
}

function kabReadDate(value) {
  const text = kabDigits(value).trim();
  if (/^\d{4}-\d{2}-\d{2}$/.test(text)) return Ql(text);
  const parts = /^(\d{1,2})[\/.\-](\d{1,2})[\/.\-](\d{4})$/.exec(text);
  if (!parts) throw Error("اكتب التاريخ بالترتيب يوم/شهر/سنة.");
  return Ql(parts[3] + "-" + parts[2].padStart(2, "0") + "-" + parts[1].padStart(2, "0"));
}

function kabBonus(value) {
  const text = String(value ?? "").trim();
  return /^[\d٠-٩۰-۹,\.٬ ]*$/.test(text) ? {bonus: kabMoney(text, "العرض"), bonusText: ""}
    : {bonus: 0, bonusText: text.slice(0, 300)};
}

function kabLinePrice(line) {
  return line.useNet && line.netPriceTarget === "pharmacy" ? line.netPrice : line.price;
}

function kabNetPrice(price) {
  return Math.round(Number(price) * 33 / 20000) * 500;
}

function kabProductNetPrice(product) {
  return product.netOverride ?? kabNetPrice(product.price);
}

function kabPartyLabel(party) {
  if (!party) return "—";
  return party.name + (party.area ? " (" + party.area + ")" : "");
}

function kabOrder(left, right) {
  return left.date.localeCompare(right.date)
    || String(left.createdAt || "").localeCompare(String(right.createdAt || ""))
    || (left.createdOrder || 0) - (right.createdOrder || 0);
}

function kabNextDocumentNumber(state, kind) {
  const prefix = kind === "sale" ? "KAB-" : kind === "receipt" ? "REC-" : "DOC-";
  const deleted = (state.deletedDocs || []).map(item => item.doc);
  let largest = 0;
  for (const doc of [...state.docs, ...deleted]) {
    if (doc.number?.startsWith(prefix) && (kind !== "sale" || doc.kind === "sale")) {
      const number = Number(doc.number.slice(prefix.length));
      if (Number.isSafeInteger(number)) largest = Math.max(largest, number);
    }
  }
  return prefix + String(largest + 1).padStart(6, "0");
}

// FIFO balances with dated credit lots. Dates on credit follow the original collection.
function kabProject(state) {
  const bills = new Map();
  const parties = new Map();
  const cashByMonth = new Map();
  const collectorReceipts = [];
  function account(id) {
    if (!parties.has(id)) parties.set(id, {bills: [], wallet: [], opening: 0, nextUnpaid: 0});
    return parties.get(id);
  }
  function cash(date, amount) {
    const month = date.slice(0, 7);
    cashByMonth.set(month, (cashByMonth.get(month) || 0) + amount);
  }
  function apply(bill, lot) {
    const value = Math.min(bill.remaining, lot.amount);
    if (value > 0) {
      bill.allocations.push({...lot, amount: value});
      bill.remaining -= value;
      lot.amount -= value;
    }
    return value;
  }
  function credit(customer, lot) {
    if (lot.amount > 0) {
      customer.wallet.push(lot);
      customer.wallet.sort((a, b) => a.date.localeCompare(b.date));
    }
  }
  function collect(customer, lot, target) {
    if (target) {
      target.paymentRecorded = true;
      apply(target, lot);
    }
    const openingPaid = Math.min(lot.amount, customer.opening);
    customer.opening -= openingPaid;
    lot.amount -= openingPaid;
    while (lot.amount > 0 && customer.nextUnpaid < customer.bills.length) {
      const bill = customer.bills[customer.nextUnpaid];
      if (apply(bill, lot) > 0) bill.paymentRecorded = true;
      if (bill.remaining > 0) break;
      customer.nextUnpaid++;
    }
    credit(customer, lot);
  }
  for (const doc of [...state.docs].sort(kabOrder)) {
    const id = doc.party?.id;
    if (!id || doc.party.kind !== "customer") continue;
    const customer = account(id);
    if (doc.kind === "sale") {
      const bill = {
        id: doc.id, doc, party: id, total: doc.total, net: doc.total, returned: 0,
        remaining: doc.total, allocations: [], creditAtIssue: 0, returns: [],
        previousBalance: customer.opening + customer.bills.reduce((sum, item) => sum + item.remaining, 0)
          - customer.wallet.reduce((sum, lot) => sum + lot.amount, 0)
      };
      const paid = doc.paidAtIssue ?? (doc.method === "credit" ? 0 : doc.total);
      if (paid > 0) {
        const lot = {amount: paid, date: doc.date, cash: true};
        cash(doc.date, paid);
        apply(bill, lot);
        credit(customer, lot);
      }
      for (const lot of doc.source?.includePreviousBalance === false ? [] : customer.wallet) {
        if (bill.remaining <= 0) break;
        bill.creditAtIssue += apply(bill, lot);
      }
      customer.wallet = customer.wallet.filter(lot => lot.amount > 0);
      customer.bills.push(bill);
      bills.set(doc.id, bill);
    } else if (doc.kind === "receipt") {
      cash(doc.date, doc.total);
      if (doc.collector) collectorReceipts.push(doc);
      const target = bills.get(doc.invoice);
      collect(customer, {amount: doc.total, date: doc.date, cash: true}, target?.party === id ? target : null);
    } else if (doc.kind === "party_opening") {
      const change = doc.entries.filter(entry => entry.account === "1200" && entry.party === id)
        .reduce((sum, entry) => sum + entry.debit - entry.credit, 0);
      if (change < 0) credit(customer, {amount: -change, date: doc.date, cash: false});
      else customer.opening += change;
    } else if (doc.kind === "return_credit") {
      const bill = bills.get(doc.invoice);
      if (!bill || bill.party !== id) continue;
      let left = doc.total;
      for (const lot of customer.wallet) {
        if (!lot.returnCredit || !left) continue;
        const applied = apply(bill, {...lot, appliedReturnCredit: true, amount: Math.min(left, lot.amount)});
        lot.amount -= applied;
        left -= applied;
        if (applied) bill.paymentRecorded = true;
      }
      customer.wallet = customer.wallet.filter(lot => lot.amount > 0);
    } else if (doc.kind === "sale_return") {
      if (!doc.original) {
        credit(customer, {amount: doc.total, date: doc.date, cash: false, returnCredit: true, returnDocument: doc});
        continue;
      }
      const bill = bills.get(doc.original);
      if (!bill) continue;
      bill.returns.push(doc);
      const refund = doc.entries.filter(entry => ["1100", "1110"].includes(entry.account))
        .reduce((sum, entry) => sum + entry.credit - entry.debit, 0);
      if (refund > 0) cash(doc.date, -refund);
      bill.returned += doc.total;
      bill.net = Math.max(0, bill.total - bill.returned);
      const paidBefore = bill.allocations.reduce((sum, lot) => sum + lot.amount, 0);
      let excess = Math.max(0, paidBefore - bill.net);
      let refundLeft = refund;
      for (let i = bill.allocations.length - 1; i >= 0 && excess > 0; i--) {
        const lot = bill.allocations[i];
        const released = Math.min(excess, lot.amount);
        const refunded = Math.min(released, refundLeft);
        refundLeft -= refunded;
        lot.amount -= released;
        excess -= released;
        credit(customer, {...lot, appliedReturnCredit: false, amount: released - refunded});
      }
      bill.allocations = bill.allocations.filter(lot => lot.amount > 0);
      bill.remaining = Math.max(0, bill.net - bill.allocations.reduce((sum, lot) => sum + lot.amount, 0));

    }
  }
  for (const bill of bills.values()) {
    bill.paid = bill.net - bill.remaining;
    bill.returnCreditApplied = bill.allocations.reduce((sum, lot) => sum + (lot.appliedReturnCredit ? lot.amount : 0), 0);
    bill.cashPaid = bill.allocations.reduce((sum, lot) => sum + (lot.cash ? lot.amount : 0), 0);
    const waiting = bill.doc.source?.deliveryReviewed === false && !bill.paymentRecorded;
    bill.status = waiting ? "pending" : bill.remaining <= 0 ? "settled" : bill.paid > 0 ? "partial"
      : bill.doc.source?.debtConfirmed ? "debt" : "pending";
  }
  return {bills, parties, cashByMonth, collectorReceipts};
}

// Legacy validation/replay uses the same payment allocation as the visible invoice.
function Yi(state, partyId) {
  return [...kabProject(state).bills.values()].filter(bill => !partyId || bill.party === partyId);
}

function kabAccountTotals(projected, partyId) {
  const account = projected.parties.get(partyId);
  return {
    outstanding: account ? account.opening + account.bills.reduce((sum, bill) => sum + bill.remaining, 0) : 0,
    credit: account ? account.wallet.reduce((sum, lot) => sum + lot.amount, 0) : 0
  };
}

function kabCommissions(state, projected, month = "", invoiceBalances = projected.bills) {
  const rows = new Map();
  const roles = [
    {key: "rep", rate: "repRate", label: "مندوب"},
    {key: "distributor", rate: "distRate", label: "موزّع"},
    {key: "collector", rate: "collectorRate", label: "محصّل"}
  ];
  function row(person, role) {
    const key = person.id + "/" + role.key;
    if (!rows.has(key)) {
      const current = state.reps.find(item => item.id === person.id) || person;
      rows.set(key, {
        key, person: current, role: role.key, label: role.label, rate: Number(current[role.rate]) || 0,
        total: 0, paid: 0, cashPaid: 0, remaining: 0, commission: 0, returned: 0, netSales: 0
      });
    }
    return rows.get(key);
  }
  for (const person of state.reps.filter(person => !person.archived)) {
    if (person.isRep !== false) row(person, roles[0]);
    if (person.isDistributor) row(person, roles[1]);
    if (person.isCollector) row(person, roles[2]);
  }
  for (const bill of projected.bills.values()) {
    const paid = bill.allocations.reduce((sum, lot) => sum + (lot.cash && (!month || lot.date.slice(0, 7) === month) ? lot.amount : 0), 0);
    const invoice = !month || bill.doc.date.slice(0, 7) === month ? invoiceBalances.get(bill.id) : null;
    if (!invoice && !paid) continue;
    for (const role of roles.slice(0, 2)) {
      const person = bill.doc[role.key];
      if (!person?.id) continue;
      const current = row(person, role);
      current.total += invoice ? (month ? invoice.total : invoice.net) : 0;
      current.paid += month ? paid : bill.paid;
      current.cashPaid += paid;
      current.remaining += invoice?.remaining ?? 0;
    }
  }
  for (const doc of state.docs) {
    if (doc.kind !== "sale_return" || (month && doc.date.slice(0, 7) !== month)) continue;
    const original = projected.bills.get(doc.original)?.doc;
    if (!original) continue;
    for (const role of roles.slice(0, 2)) {
      if (original[role.key]?.id) {
        const current = row(original[role.key], role);
        current.returned += doc.total;
      }
    }
  }
  for (const receipt of projected.collectorReceipts) {
    if (month && receipt.date.slice(0, 7) !== month) continue;
    const current = row(receipt.collector, roles[2]);
    current.paid += receipt.total;
    current.cashPaid += receipt.total;
  }
  const result = [...rows.values()];
  for (const item of result) {
    item.commission = Math.round(item.cashPaid * item.rate / 100);
    item.netSales = item.total - (month ? item.returned : 0);
  }
  return result.sort((a, b) => a.person.name.localeCompare(b.person.name, "ar") || a.role.localeCompare(b.role));
}

function kabMonthly(state, projected, month) {
  const collected = projected.cashByMonth.get(month) || 0;
  const commissions = kabCommissions(state, projected, month).reduce((sum, row) => sum + row.commission, 0);
  return {collected, commissions, net: collected - commissions};
}

function kabCustomerDocument(state, payload, actor, replay) {
  const date = Ql(payload.date);
  if (!replay && state.settings.closedThrough && date <= state.settings.closedThrough) throw Error("الفترة المحاسبية مقفلة.");
  const party = state.parties.find(item => item.id === payload.party && item.kind === "customer");
  if (!party) throw Error("اختر الصيدلية.");
  const doc = {id: payload.id || crypto.randomUUID(), number: replay?.number || kabNextDocumentNumber(state, payload.kind),
    kind: payload.kind, date, createdAt: new Date().toISOString(), createdBy: actor, party: structuredClone(party),
    company: structuredClone(state.settings), note: String(payload.note || "").trim(), entries: [], moves: [], lines: [],
    source: structuredClone(payload)};
  doc.source.id = doc.id;
  if (doc.kind === "sale_return") {
    doc.lines = (payload.lines || []).map(line => {
      const product = state.products.find(item => item.id === line.product && item.kind === "finished");
      const qty = kabMoney(line.qty, "العدد");
      const price = kabMoney(line.price, "السعر");
      if (!product || !qty) throw Error("اختر الصنف والعدد.");
      return {product: product.id, name: line.name || product.name, unit: line.unit || product.unit, qty, price, publicPrice: line.publicPrice == null || line.publicPrice === "" ? product.publicPrice : kabMoney(line.publicPrice, "سعر العموم"), amount: qty * price};
    });
    doc.total = doc.lines.reduce((sum, line) => sum + line.amount, 0);
    if (!Number.isSafeInteger(doc.total) || doc.total <= 0) throw Error("أدخل أصنافاً بقيمة مرتجع صحيحة.");
    doc.source.lines = structuredClone(doc.lines);
    doc.entries = [{account: "4100", party: "", debit: doc.total, credit: 0},
      {account: "1200", party: party.id, debit: 0, credit: doc.total}];
  } else {
    doc.invoice = payload.invoice;
    doc.total = kabMoney(payload.total);
    const projected = kabProject({...state, docs: state.docs.filter(item => item.date <= date)});
    const bill = projected.bills.get(doc.invoice);
    const available = (projected.parties.get(party.id)?.wallet || []).reduce((sum, lot) => sum + (lot.returnCredit ? lot.amount : 0), 0);
    if (!bill || bill.party !== party.id || !doc.total || doc.total > Math.min(available, bill.remaining)) {
      throw Error("المبلغ لازم يكون ضمن رصيد المرتجعات والمتبقي على الفاتورة.");
    }
  }
  let order = state.docs.length + (state.deletedDocs?.length || 0);
  for (const existing of [...state.docs, ...(state.deletedDocs || []).map(item => item.doc)]) {
    if (Number.isSafeInteger(existing.createdOrder)) order = Math.max(order, existing.createdOrder);
  }
  doc.createdOrder = replay && Number.isSafeInteger(payload.createdOrder) ? payload.createdOrder : order + 1;
  doc.source.createdOrder = doc.createdOrder;
  return {...state, docs: [...state.docs, doc], audit: [...state.audit, {
    id: crypto.randomUUID(), at: doc.createdAt, actor, ref: doc.id, what: doc.kind === "return_credit" ? "تطبيق رصيد مرتجع" : "مرتجع مستقل"
  }]};
}

function Qi(state, action, actor, replay) {
  state = kabRemoveOldExchanges(state);
  const payload = action.payload || {};
  if (!state.members.some(person => person.email.toLowerCase() === actor.toLowerCase())) throw Error("لا توجد صلاحية.");
  if (action.type === "exchange_note" || action.type === "exchange_note_delete") {
    if (!state.members.some(person => person.email.toLowerCase() === actor.toLowerCase() && person.role === "admin")) throw Error("القسم خاص بالإدارة.");
    const notes = state.exchangeNotes || [];
    const current = notes.find(item => item.id === payload.id);
    if (payload.id && !current) throw Error("فاتورة التبديل غير موجودة.");
    if (action.type === "exchange_note_delete") return {...state, exchangeNotes: notes.filter(item => item.id !== payload.id)};
    const party = state.parties.find(item => item.id === payload.party && item.kind === "customer");
    if (!party) throw Error("اختر الصيدلية.");
    const lines = (payload.lines || [{product: payload.product, qty: payload.qty}]).filter(line => line.product).map(line => {
      const product = state.products.find(item => item.id === line.product && item.kind === "finished");
      const qty = kabMoney(line.qty, "العدد");
      if (!product || !qty) throw Error("اختر الصنف والعدد.");
      return {product: product.id, name: product.name, qty};
    });
    if (!lines.length) throw Error("أضف صنفاً واحداً على الأقل.");
    const record = {id: current?.id || crypto.randomUUID(), date: current?.date || an(),
      partyId: party.id, party: kabPartyLabel(party), lines, note: String(payload.note || "").trim()};
    return {...state, exchangeNotes: current ? notes.map(item => item.id === current.id ? record : item) : [...notes, record]};
  }
  if (action.type === "document" && ((payload.kind === "sale_return" && !payload.original) || payload.kind === "return_credit")) {
    return kabCustomerDocument(state, payload, actor, replay);
  }
  if (action.type === "document" && payload.salesWorkflow && (payload.original || payload.invoice)) {
    const linked = state.docs.find(doc => doc.id === (payload.original || payload.invoice));
    if (linked && payload.date < linked.date) throw Error("تاريخ الحركة يجب أن يكون في يوم الفاتورة أو بعده.");
  }
  const next = kabLegacyApply(state, action, actor, replay);
  if (action.type === "document") {
    const doc = next.docs.at(-1);
    let order = state.docs.length + (state.deletedDocs?.length || 0);
    for (const existing of [...state.docs, ...(state.deletedDocs || []).map(record => record.doc)]) {
      if (Number.isSafeInteger(existing.createdOrder)) order = Math.max(order, existing.createdOrder);
    }
    doc.createdOrder = replay && Number.isSafeInteger(payload.createdOrder) ? payload.createdOrder : order + 1;
    doc.source.createdOrder = doc.createdOrder;
    if (doc.kind === "receipt" && payload.receivedBy) {
      const receiver = state.reps.find(person => person.id === payload.receivedBy);
      const sale = state.docs.find(item => item.id === doc.invoice);
      if (!receiver || !sale) throw Error("اختر فاتورة واسم الشخص الذي قبض الدفعة.");
      doc.receivedBy = structuredClone(receiver);
      if (sale.distributor?.id !== receiver.id) {
        const before = kabProject({...state, docs: state.docs.filter(item => item.date <= doc.date)}).bills.get(sale.id);
        if (!receiver.isCollector || !before || !["debt", "partial"].includes(before.status) || doc.total > before.remaining) {
          throw Error("دفعة المحصّل لازم تكون على فاتورة مديونة وبحدود المتبقي عليها.");
        }
        doc.collector = structuredClone(receiver);
      }
    }
  }
  if (action.type === "document_edit" && payload.returning) {
    const invoice = next.docs.find(doc => doc.id === payload.id && doc.kind === "sale");
    if (!invoice) throw Error("اختر فاتورة مبيعات.");
    const lines = payload.returning.lines?.map(line => {
      const index = invoice.source.lines.findIndex(item => item.sourceIndex === line.index);
      if (index < 0 || invoice.lines[index]?.product !== line.product) {
        throw Error("صنف المرتجع تغيّر أثناء تعديل الفاتورة. احفظ تعديل الأصناف ثم اختر المرتجع.");
      }
      return {...line, index};
    });
    const afterReturn = Qi(next, {type: "document", payload: {
      kind: "sale_return", salesWorkflow: true, original: invoice.id, date: payload.returning.date,
      ...(lines ? {lines} : {returnAmount: kabMoney(payload.returning.total, "مبلغ المرتجع")})
    }}, actor);
    return payload.receipt
      ? Qi(afterReturn, {type: "document", payload: {
        kind: "receipt", salesWorkflow: true, invoice: invoice.id, party: invoice.party.id,
        date: payload.receipt.date, method: payload.receipt.method, total: payload.receipt.total, receivedBy: payload.receipt.receivedBy
      }}, actor) : afterReturn;
  }
  if (action.type === "document_edit" && payload.receipt) {
    const invoice = next.docs.find(doc => doc.id === payload.id && doc.kind === "sale");
    if (!invoice) throw Error("اختر فاتورة مبيعات لتسجيل الدفعة.");
    const {date, method} = payload.receipt;
    const total = kabMoney(payload.receipt.total, "المبلغ المقبوض");
    if (total <= 0) throw Error("أدخل مبلغ دفعة أكبر من صفر.");
    return Qi(next, {type: "document", payload: {
      kind: "receipt", salesWorkflow: true, invoice: invoice.id, party: invoice.party.id, date, method, total, receivedBy: payload.receipt.receivedBy
    }}, actor);
  }
  if (action.type === "product") {
    const product = payload.id ? next.products.find(item => item.id === payload.id) : next.products.at(-1);
    const old = state.products.find(item => item.id === product.id);
    if (old?.archived) product.archived = true;
    product.netOverride = Object.hasOwn(payload, "netOverride")
      ? (kabDigits(payload.netOverride).trim() ? kabMoney(payload.netOverride, "السعر الصافي") : null)
      : old?.netOverride ?? null;
  } else if (action.type === "rep") {
    const person = payload.id ? next.reps.find(item => item.id === payload.id) : next.reps.at(-1);
    const old = state.reps.find(item => item.id === person.id);
    person.isRep = payload.isRep ?? old?.isRep ?? true;
    person.isDistributor = payload.isDistributor ?? old?.isDistributor ?? false;
    person.isCollector = payload.isCollector ?? old?.isCollector ?? false;
    if (!person.isRep && !person.isDistributor && !person.isCollector) throw Error("اختر دوراً واحداً على الأقل.");
    person.repRate = kabPercent(payload.repRate ?? old?.repRate);
    person.distRate = kabPercent(payload.distRate ?? old?.distRate);
    person.collectorRate = kabPercent(payload.collectorRate ?? old?.collectorRate);
    if (old?.archived) person.archived = true;
  } else if (action.type === "party") {
    const party = payload.id ? next.parties.find(item => item.id === payload.id) : next.parties.at(-1);
    const old = state.parties.find(item => item.id === party.id);
    if (old?.archived) party.archived = true;
    if (party.kind === "customer") {
      const governorate = String(payload.governorate ?? old?.governorate ?? "").trim().replace(/\s+/g, " ");
      const names = [...new Set([...(state.governorates || []), ...state.parties.map(item => item.governorate).filter(Boolean)])];
      party.governorate = names.find(name => name.toLowerCase() === governorate.toLowerCase()) || governorate;
      if (party.governorate && !names.includes(party.governorate)) names.push(party.governorate);
      next.governorates = names;
    }
  } else if (action.type === "document" && payload.kind === "sale") {
    const doc = next.docs.at(-1);
    doc.source.deliveryReviewed = replay ? payload.deliveryReviewed : false;
    doc.source.debtConfirmed = replay ? !!payload.debtConfirmed : false;
    for (const [role, label] of [["distributor", "الموزّع"]]) {
      if (!payload[role]) continue;
      const person = next.reps.find(item => item.id === payload[role]);
      if (!person) throw Error("اختر " + label + " من القائمة.");
      doc[role] = structuredClone(person);
    }
  }
  return next;
}

function KabProductPicker({products, value, onChange, placeholder = "اختر المنتج", searchLabel = "بحث عن المنتج", disabled, multiple, ...props}) {
  const [open, setOpen] = Me.useState(false);
  const [query, setQuery] = Me.useState("");
  const [selected, setSelected] = Me.useState(0);
  const searchRef = Me.useRef(null);
  const rootRef = Me.useRef(null);
  const listRef = Me.useRef(null);
  const [placement, setPlacement] = Me.useState({});
  const selectedValues = Array.isArray(value) ? value : [];
  const label = multiple
    ? products.filter(item => selectedValues.includes(item.id)).map(item => item.name).join("، ") || placeholder
    : null;
  const product = products.find(item => item.id === value);
  const needle = kabFold(query);
  const choices = products.map(item => {
    const name = kabFold(item.name);
    const code = kabFold(item.code);
    const rank = !needle || name.startsWith(needle) || code.startsWith(needle) ? 0
      : name.split(/\s+/).some(word => word.startsWith(needle)) ? 1
      : name.includes(needle) || code.includes(needle) ? 2 : 3;
    return {item, rank};
  }).filter(choice => choice.rank < 3).sort((left, right) => left.rank - right.rank);
  function choose(item) {
    onChange(item);
    if (!multiple) { setOpen(false); setQuery(""); }
  }
  function toggle() {
    if (!open && rootRef.current) {
      const bounds = rootRef.current.getBoundingClientRect();
      const dialog = rootRef.current.closest(".k5-dialog");
      const clip = dialog?.getBoundingClientRect();
      const below = Math.min(window.innerHeight, clip?.bottom ?? window.innerHeight) - bounds.bottom - 10;
      const above = bounds.top - Math.max(0, clip?.top ?? 0) - 10;
      const upward = below < 235 && above > below;
      setPlacement({top: upward ? "auto" : "100%", bottom: upward ? "100%" : "auto",
        maxHeight: Math.max(70, Math.min(235, upward ? above : below))});
    }
    setOpen(!open); setQuery(""); setSelected(0);
  }
  Me.useLayoutEffect(() => {
    const list = listRef.current;
    const active = list?.querySelector(".k5-picker-active");
    if (!open || !active) return;
    if (selected === 0) {
      list.scrollTop = 0;
      return;
    }
    const bounds = list.getBoundingClientRect();
    const item = active.getBoundingClientRect();
    const searchHeight = searchRef.current?.getBoundingClientRect().height || 0;
    const visibleTop = bounds.top + list.clientTop + searchHeight + 4;
    const visibleBottom = bounds.top + list.clientTop + list.clientHeight - 4;
    if (item.top < visibleTop) list.scrollTop -= visibleTop - item.top;
    else if (item.bottom > visibleBottom) list.scrollTop += item.bottom - visibleBottom;
  }, [open, selected, query]);
  Me.useEffect(() => { if (open) searchRef.current?.focus(); }, [open]);
  return kabH("div", {className: "k5-product-picker", dir: "rtl", ref: rootRef,
    onBlur: event => { if (!event.currentTarget.contains(event.relatedTarget)) setOpen(false); }},
    kabH("button", {type: "button", className: "k5-picker-toggle", "aria-expanded": open, disabled, ...props,
      onClick: toggle},
      kabH("span", {className: "k5-picker-label"},
        kabH("bdi", null, multiple ? label : product?.name || placeholder),
        !multiple && product?.code && kabH("bdi", {className: "k5-picker-code"}, product.code)),
      kabH("span", {"aria-hidden": true}, "▾")),
    open && kabH("div", {className: "k5-picker-list", ref: listRef, style: placement},
      kabH("input", {ref: searchRef, value: query, dir: "auto", "aria-label": searchLabel,
        onChange: event => { setQuery(event.target.value); setSelected(0); },
        onKeyDown: event => {
          if (["ArrowDown", "ArrowUp", "Enter", "Escape"].includes(event.key)) event.preventDefault();
          if (event.key === "Escape") setOpen(false);
          if (event.key === "ArrowDown") setSelected(choices.length ? (selected + 1) % choices.length : 0);
          if (event.key === "ArrowUp") setSelected(choices.length ? (selected - 1 + choices.length) % choices.length : 0);
          if (event.key === "Enter" && choices[selected]) choose(choices[selected].item);
        }}),
      multiple && kabH("button", {type: "button", onMouseDown: event => event.preventDefault(),
        onClick: () => choose({id: ""})}, "إلغاء تحديد الكل"),
      choices.length ? choices.map(({item}, index) => kabH("button", {type: "button", key: item.id,

        onMouseDown: event => event.preventDefault(), onClick: () => choose(item)},

        : kabH("div", {className: "k5-empty"}, "لا يوجد منتج مطابق")));

function kabInvoiceAmounts(form) {
  const gross = form.lines.reduce((sum, line) => {
    if (!line.product) return sum;
    return sum + Math.round(kabMoney(line.qty, "العدد") * kabMoney(kabLinePrice(line), "سعر الصيدلي"));
  }, 0);
  const discount = form.discountMode === "percent"
    ? Math.round(gross * kabPercent(form.discountValue) / 100)
    : kabMoney(form.discountValue, "الخصم");
  if (discount > gross) throw Error("الخصم أكبر من قيمة الفاتورة.");
  return {gross, discount, total: gross - discount};
}

function kabTryNumber(callback) {

}

function kabReturnLines(selections) {

    index: Number(index), qty: kabMoney(line.qty, "عدد المرتجع"), bonus: kabMoney(line.bonus, "عرض المرتجع"),
    ...(line.returnPrice == null ? {} : {returnPrice: kabMoney(line.returnPrice, "سعر المرتجع")}),
    ...(line.returnTotal == null ? {} : {returnTotal: kabMoney(line.returnTotal, "قيمة المرتجع")})
  })).filter(line => line.qty || line.bonus);
}

function kabReturnItems(original, documents, selections, excludeId) {
  if (!original) return [];
  let previousGross = 0;
  return original.lines.map((line, index) => {
    const earlier = documents.filter(item => item.kind === "sale_return" && item.original === original.id && item.id !== excludeId)
      .flatMap(item => item.lines).filter(item => item.originalIndex === index);
    const past = kabSum(earlier, "qty");
    const pastBonus = kabSum(earlier, "bonus");
    const data = selections?.[index] || {};
    const qty = kabTryNumber(() => kabMoney(data.qty)) ?? 0;
    const allocated = line.netAmount ?? (original.gross
      ? Math.round(original.total * (previousGross + line.amount) / original.gross)
        - Math.round(original.total * previousGross / original.gross) : 0);
    previousGross += line.amount;
    const automatic = Math.round(allocated * (past + qty) / line.qty) - Math.round(allocated * past / line.qty);
    const value = data.returnTotal != null ? kabTryNumber(() => kabMoney(data.returnTotal)) ?? 0
      : data.returnPrice != null ? qty * (kabTryNumber(() => kabMoney(data.returnPrice)) ?? 0) : automatic;
    return {index, line, data, past, pastBonus, available: line.qty - past,
      unitPrice: Math.round(allocated / (line.qty || 1)), value};
  });
}

  async function submit(event) {
    event.preventDefault();
    const {type, form, doc} = modal;
    try {
      let action;
      if (type === "product") {
        action = {type, payload: {
          ...form, kind: "finished", active: true, min: 0, unit: form.unit.trim(),
          price: kabMoney(form.price, "سعر الصيدلي"), publicPrice: kabMoney(form.publicPrice, "سعر العموم")
        }};
      } else if (type === "party") {
        const governorate = form.addGovernorate ? form.newGovernorate?.trim() : form.governorate || "";
        if (form.addGovernorate && !governorate) throw Error("اكتب اسم المحافظة.");
        const {addGovernorate, newGovernorate, ...details} = form;
        action = {type, payload: {...details, governorate, kind: "customer"}};
      } else if (type === "rep") {
        action = {type, payload: {...form, repRate: kabPercent(form.repRate), distRate: kabPercent(form.distRate), collectorRate: kabPercent(form.collectorRate)}};
      } else if (type === "exchange_note") {
        action = {type, payload: form};
      } else if (type === "settings") {
        action = {type, payload: {...form, closedThrough: form.closedThrough ? kabReadDate(form.closedThrough) : ""}};
      } else {
        const date = kabReadDate(form.date);
        let document, receipt, returning;
        if (type === "sale") {
          const totals = kabInvoiceAmounts(form);
          const lines = form.lines.filter(line => line.product).map(line => {
            const regularPublicPrice = kabMoney(line.publicPrice, "سعر العموم");
            return {
              product: line.product, qty: kabMoney(line.qty, "العدد"), ...kabBonus(line.bonus),
              price: kabMoney(kabLinePrice(line), "سعر الصيدلي"), regularPrice: kabMoney(line.price, "سعر الصيدلي"),
              publicPrice: regularPublicPrice,
              regularPublicPrice, netPrice: line.netPrice, useNet: line.useNet, netPriceTarget: "pharmacy",
              sourceIndex: line.sourceIndex
            };
          });
          if (!lines.length || lines.some(line => line.qty <= 0)) throw Error("أدخل عدداً أكبر من صفر لكل منتج اخترته.");
          document = {
            kind: "sale", date, party: form.party, rep: form.rep, distributor: form.distributor, 
            method: doc?.source?.legacyMethod || (doc && !doc.source?.salesWorkflow ? doc.method : "credit"),
            legacyMethod: doc?.source?.legacyMethod || (doc && !doc.source?.salesWorkflow ? doc.method : ""),
            initialPaid: doc ? doc.paidAtIssue ?? (doc.method === "credit" ? 0 : doc.total) : 0,
            paymentAccount: doc?.paymentAccount || (doc?.method === "bank" ? "bank" : "cash"),
            paymentPreference: form.paymentPreference, salesWorkflow: true,
            discount: totals.discount, discountMode: form.discountMode, discountValue: form.discountValue,
            lines, note: form.note, includePreviousBalance: form.includePreviousBalance !== false,
            deliveryReviewed: !!doc, debtConfirmed: !!doc && !!form.debtConfirmed, showAsSettled: !!form.showAsSettled
          };
          if (doc && form.adjustmentMode === "return") {
            const lines = kabReturnLines(form.returnLines);
            if (!lines.length) throw Error("اختر صنفاً وأدخل كمية المرتجع.");
            returning = {date: kabReadDate(form.returnDate),
              lines: lines.map(line => ({...line, product: doc.lines[line.index]?.product}))};
          }
          const total = doc ? kabMoney(form.paymentAmount, "المبلغ المقبوض") : 0;
          if (total > 0) receipt = {
            total, receivedBy: receiptCollector(form, form.distributor), date: kabReadDate(form.paymentDate), method: form.paymentPreference || doc.paymentAccount || "cash"
          };
        } else if (type === "receipt") {
          const total = kabMoney(form.total);
          if (total <= 0) throw Error("أدخل مبلغ دفعة أكبر من صفر.");
          document = {kind: "receipt", salesWorkflow: true, date, total, method: form.method,
            party: form.party, invoice: form.invoice || undefined, receivedBy: receiptCollector(form, billById.get(form.invoice)?.doc.distributor?.id), note: form.note};
        } else if (type === "expense") {
          document = {kind: "expense", salesWorkflow: true, date, total: kabMoney(form.total), method: form.method, note: form.note};
        } else if (type === "journal") {
          const lines = form.lines.filter(line => line.account).map(line => ({
            account: line.account, debit: kabMoney(line.debit), credit: kabMoney(line.credit)
          }));
          document = {kind: "journal", date, note: form.note, lines};
        } else if (type === "return_credit") {
          document = {kind: type, date, invoice: form.invoice, party: form.party, total: kabMoney(form.total)};
        } else if (type === "sale_return" && !form.original) {
          document = {kind: type, salesWorkflow: true, date, party: form.party, note: form.note, lines: form.itemLines};
        } else if (type === "sale_return") {
          const amountOnly = form.amountOnly;
          const lines = kabReturnLines(form.lines);
          if (!amountOnly && !lines.length) throw Error("أدخل كمية مرتجعة.");
          document = {kind: "sale_return", salesWorkflow: true, date, original: form.original,
            lines: amountOnly ? [] : lines, note: form.note,
            ...(amountOnly ? {returnAmount: kabMoney(form.returnAmount)} : {})};
        }
        action = doc
          ? {type: "document_edit", payload: {id: doc.id, reason: "تعديل المستند", document, receipt, returning}}
          : {type: "document", payload: document};
      }
      if (await save(action)) setModal(null);
    } catch (failure) {
      setError(failure.message);
    }
  }

  async function printDocument(id) {
    if (lock.current) return;
    lock.current = true;
    setBusy(true);
    setError("");
    try {
      const latest = await transport.load();
      const doc = latest.state.docs.find(item => item.id === id);
      if (!doc) throw Error("الفاتورة غير موجودة. حدّث القائمة.");
      setWorkspace(latest);
      const bill = kabProject(latest.state).bills.get(id);
      await kabPrint(doc, bill);
    } catch (failure) {
      setError(failure.message);
    } finally {
      lock.current = false;
      setBusy(false);
    }
  }

    const draft = {id: doc?.id || "draft", date, createdAt: doc?.createdAt || new Date().toISOString(),
      createdOrder: doc ? doc.createdOrder || 0 : Number.MAX_SAFE_INTEGER};
    const chronological = (doc ? state.docs.map(item => item.id === doc.id ? draft : item)
      : [...state.docs, draft]).sort(kabOrder);
    const earlier = chronological.slice(0, chronological.indexOf(draft));
    const account = kabAccountTotals(kabProject({...state, docs: earlier}), form.party);
    const previousBalance = account.outstanding - account.credit;
    const prior = form.includePreviousBalance !== false ? previousBalance : 0;
    const returnAmount = form.adjustmentMode === "return"
      ? kabReturnItems(doc, state.docs, form.returnLines).reduce((sum, item) => sum + item.value, 0) : 0;
    function textOrder() {
      try {
        const lines = modal.textOrder.split(/\n/).map(text => text.trim()).filter(Boolean).map(text => {
          const match = /^(.+?)\s*(?:[،,;×:\t]\s*|\s+)([\d٠-٩۰-۹]+)$/.exec(text);
          if (!match) throw Error("اكتب اسم المنتج ثم العدد في السطر: " + text);
          const key = kabFold(match[1]);
          const matches = products.filter(product => [product.name, product.code].some(value => kabFold(value) === key));
          if (matches.length !== 1) throw Error("اختر المنتج يدوياً لهذا السطر: " + text);
          const product = matches[0];
          return {...kabLineProduct(product), qty: kabDigits(match[2]), bonus: 0};
        });
        if (!lines.length) throw Error("ألصق طلباً أولاً.");
        update("lines", lines);
        setModal(current => ({...current, showOrder: false}));

        hint: doc ? undefined : "بعد حفظ الفاتورة، اضغط «تسجيل دفعة» لإدخال المبلغ."
      }),

  function returnForm(form, doc, embedded = false) {
    const bill = billById.get(embedded ? doc.id : form.original);
    const original = bill?.doc;
    const key = embedded ? "returnLines" : "lines";
    const candidates = [...bills].reverse().map(item => [item.id, item.doc.number + " · " + kabPartyLabel(item.doc.party)]);
    const rows = kabReturnItems(original, state.docs, form[key], embedded ? undefined : doc?.id).map(item => {
      const {index, line, data, pastBonus, available, unitPrice, value} = item;
      const selected = !!data.selected;
      const edit = changes => setModal(current => ({...current, form: {...current.form, [key]: {
        ...current.form[key], [index]: {...current.form[key]?.[index], ...changes}
      }}}));
      const inputProps = {inputMode: "decimal", dir: "ltr", disabled: embedded && !selected};
      return {...item, row: [index,
        ...(embedded ? [kabH("input", {type: "checkbox", checked: selected,
          "aria-label": "اختيار مرتجع " + line.name,
          disabled: available <= 0 && (line.bonus || 0) <= pastBonus,
          onChange: event => edit({selected: event.target.checked,
            qty: event.target.checked && available > 0 ? data.qty || 1 : 0,
            bonus: event.target.checked && available <= 0 ? 1 : 0, returnTotal: null})})] : []),
        line.name, kabFmt(available), kabFmt((line.bonus || 0) - pastBonus),
        kabH(KabInput, {...inputProps, value: data.qty ?? "0",
          onChange: value => edit({qty: value, returnTotal: null}), "aria-label": "كمية مرتجعة " + line.name}),
        kabH(KabInput, {...inputProps, value: data.bonus ?? "0",
          onChange: value => edit({bonus: value}), "aria-label": "عرض مرتجع " + line.name}),
        kabH(KabInput, {...inputProps, value: data.returnPrice ?? unitPrice,
          onChange: value => edit({returnPrice: value, returnTotal: null}), "aria-label": "سعر مرتجع " + line.name}),
        kabH(KabInput, {...inputProps, value: data.returnTotal ?? value,
          onChange: value => edit({returnTotal: value}), "aria-label": "قيمة مرتجع " + line.name})]};
    });
    const amountOnly = !embedded && form.amountOnly;
    const amount = amountOnly ? kabTryNumber(() => kabMoney(form.returnAmount)) || 0
      : rows.reduce((sum, row) => sum + row.value, 0);
    const beforeEdit = doc && !embedded ? kabProject({...state, docs: state.docs.filter(item => item.id !== doc.id)}).bills.get(form.original) : bill;
    const availableBalance = beforeEdit?.remaining || 0;
    return kabH(Me.Fragment, null,
      !embedded && field("الفاتورة الأصلية", select(form, "original", candidates, "اختر الفاتورة", {
        required: true, disabled: !!doc,
        onChange: originalId => setModal(current => ({...current, form: {...current.form, original: originalId, lines: {}}}))
      })),
      embedded && kabH("strong", null, "اختر الأصناف المرتجعة"),

      amountOnly && field("مبلغ المرتجع", input(form, "returnAmount", {...moneyProps, required: true})),
      original && kabH("div", {className: "k5-wide"},
        !amountOnly && kabH(KabTable, {headers: [...(embedded ? ["اختيار"] : []), "الصنف", "متاح للإرجاع", "عرض متاح", "العدد المرتجع", "عرض مرتجع", "السعر", "القيمة"], rows: rows.map(row => row.row)}),
        kabH("div", {className: "k5-invoice-totals"},
          kabH("strong", null, "قيمة المرتجع ", kabH("bdi", null, kabFmt(amount))),
          kabH("span", null, "ينقص من المتبقي ", kabH("bdi", null, kabFmt(Math.min(availableBalance, amount)))),
          kabH("span", null, "يضاف للرصيد ", kabH("bdi", null, kabFmt(Math.max(0, amount - availableBalance)))))),
      !embedded && noteField(form));
  }

function kabPrintNode(tag, text, className) {
  const node = document.createElement(tag);
  if (text != null) node.textContent = text;
  if (className) node.className = className;
  return node;
}

function kabInvoicePaper(doc, bill) {
  const returning = doc.kind === "sale_return";

  paper.dir = "rtl";
  const top = kabPrintNode("header", null, "k5-paper-header");

  logo.src = "data:image/png;base64,";
  logo.alt = "KAB PHARMA";

  logo.height = 119;
  brand.append(logo, kabPrintNode("div", doc.company?.company || "شركة كاب فارما", "k5-paper-company"));
  const heading = kabPrintNode("div", null, "k5-paper-heading");
  heading.append(kabPrintNode("h2", returning ? "مرتجع مبيعات" : "فاتورة مبيعات"));
  const number = kabPrintNode("bdi", doc.number + "  ·  " + kabDisplayDate(doc.date));
  heading.append(number);
  if (!returning && doc.source?.showAsSettled) heading.append(kabPrintNode("div", "مسدّدة"));
  top.append(brand, heading);
  paper.append(top);

  const contact = kabPrintNode("div", null, "k5-paper-contact");
  function line(label, value) {
    const cell = kabPrintNode("div");
    cell.append(kabPrintNode("strong", label + " "), document.createTextNode(value || "—"));
    return cell;
  }
  contact.append(
    line("الصيدلية:", doc.party?.name), line("المنطقة:", doc.party?.area),
    line("المندوب:", doc.rep?.name), line("الهاتف:", doc.rep?.phone),
    line("العنوان:", doc.party?.address)
  );
  paper.append(contact);
  const table = kabPrintNode("table", null, "k5-paper-table");
  const head = table.createTHead().insertRow();
  const hasNetPrice = !returning && doc.lines.some(item => item.useNet && item.netPriceTarget === "pharmacy");
  const priceHeading = hasNetPrice ? "سعر الصيدلي / الصافي" : "سعر الصيدلي";
  const headers = returning ? ["#", "المنتج", "السعة", "العدد", doc.original ? "عرض" : "السعر", "القيمة"]
    : ["#", "المنتج", "السعة", "العدد", "عرض", priceHeading, "سعر العموم", "الإجمالي"];
  for (const label of headers) head.append(kabPrintNode("th", label));
  const body = table.createTBody();
  doc.lines.forEach((item, index) => {
    const row = body.insertRow();
    const values = returning ? [index + 1, item.name, item.unit, kabFmt(item.qty), doc.original ? item.bonusText || kabFmt(item.bonus) : kabFmt(item.price), kabFmt(item.amount)]
      : [index + 1, item.name, item.unit, kabFmt(item.qty), item.bonusText || kabFmt(item.bonus), kabFmt(item.price), kabFmt(item.publicPrice), kabFmt(item.amount)];
    values.forEach((value, column) => {
      const cell = row.insertCell();
      cell.textContent = value == null ? "" : String(value);
      if (column !== 1 && column !== 2) cell.dir = column === 4 && item.bonusText ? "auto" : "ltr";
    });
  });
  if (returning && !doc.lines.length) {
    const row = body.insertRow();
    const label = row.insertCell();
    label.colSpan = 5;
    label.textContent = "مرتجع بقيمة";
    row.insertCell().textContent = kabFmt(doc.total);
  }
  paper.append(table, kabPrintNode("div", "جميع المبالغ بالليرة السورية", "k5-paper-currency"));

  function returnDetails(parent, entry) {
    const returnsTable = kabPrintNode("table", null, "k5-paper-table k5-returns-table");
    const returnsHead = returnsTable.createTHead().insertRow();
    for (const label of ["الصنف المرتجع", "العدد", "سعر العموم (ل.س)", "سعر الصيدلي (ل.س)", "الإجمالي (ل.س)"]) returnsHead.append(kabPrintNode("th", label));
    const returnsBody = returnsTable.createTBody();
    const lines = entry.lines.length ? entry.lines : [{name: "مرتجع بمبلغ", amount: entry.total}];
    for (const item of lines) {
      const row = returnsBody.insertRow();
      const quantity = item.qty == null ? "—" : kabFmt(item.qty) + (item.bonus ? " + " + kabFmt(item.bonus) + " عرض" : "");
      const price = item.returnPrice ?? item.price;
      const values = [item.name, quantity, item.publicPrice == null ? "—" : kabFmt(item.publicPrice),
        price == null ? "—" : kabFmt(price), kabFmt(item.amount)];
      values.forEach((value, index) => {
        const cell = row.insertCell();
        cell.textContent = value;
        if (index > 1) cell.dir = "ltr";
      });
    }
    parent.append(returnsTable);
  }

  if (!returning) {
    const credits = new Map();
    for (const lot of bill?.allocations || []) {
      const entry = lot.returnDocument;
      if (!entry) continue;
      const credit = credits.get(entry.id) || {entry, applied: 0, previous: 0};
      if (lot.appliedReturnCredit) credit.applied += lot.amount;
      else credit.previous += lot.amount;
      credits.set(entry.id, credit);
    }

    if (bill?.returns?.length || credits.size) {
      const section = kabPrintNode("section", null, "k5-paper-returns");
      section.append(kabPrintNode("h3", "الأصناف المرتجعة"));
      for (const entry of bill?.returns || []) {
        section.append(kabPrintNode("div", "تفاصيل المرتجع " + entry.number + " · " + kabDisplayDate(entry.date), "k5-paper-return-ref"));
        returnDetails(section, entry);
      }
      for (const {entry, applied, previous} of credits.values()) {
        section.append(kabPrintNode("div", "تفاصيل المرتجع " + entry.number + " · " + kabDisplayDate(entry.date), "k5-paper-return-ref"));
        returnDetails(section, entry);
        if (previous) section.append(line("من رصيد المرتجع السابق:", kabFmt(previous) + " ل.س"));
        if (applied) section.append(line("رصيد مرتجع مطبّق على الفاتورة:", kabFmt(applied) + " ل.س"));
      }
      paper.append(section);
    }
  }

  const bottom = kabPrintNode("footer", null, "k5-paper-footer");
  const totals = kabPrintNode("div", null, "k5-paper-totals");
  const gross = doc.gross ?? doc.total + (doc.discount || 0);
  const prior = returning || doc.source?.includePreviousBalance === false ? 0
    : bill?.previousBalance ?? -(bill?.creditAtIssue || 0);
  const returned = returning ? 0 : bill?.returned || 0;
  const returnCredit = returning ? 0 : bill?.returnCreditApplied || 0;
  function amount(label, value, total = false) {
    const row = kabPrintNode("div", null, total ? "k5-paper-grand" : "");
    row.append(kabPrintNode("span", label), kabPrintNode("bdi", kabFmt(value) + " ل.س"));
    totals.append(row);
  }
  amount(returning ? "قيمة المرتجع" : "قيمة الفاتورة", gross);
  if (!returning && doc.discount > 0) amount("خصم الصيدلية", doc.discount);
  if (returned > 0) amount("المرتجعات", returned);
  if (prior !== 0) amount("الرصيد السابق", prior);
  if (returnCredit > 0) amount("رصيد مرتجع مطبّق", returnCredit);
  amount("المجموع الكلي", doc.total - returned + prior - returnCredit, true);
  bottom.append(totals);
  if (doc.note?.trim()) {
    const note = line("ملاحظة:", doc.note);
    note.className = "k5-paper-note";
    bottom.append(note);
  }
  if (doc.company?.footer) bottom.append(kabPrintNode("small", doc.company.footer, "k5-paper-thanks"));
  paper.append(bottom);
  return paper;
}

function kabClearPrint() {
  document.getElementById("kab5-print-root")?.remove();
  document.body.classList.remove("k5-printing");
}

async function kabPreparePrint(doc, bill) {
  kabClearPrint();
  const root = kabPrintNode("div");
  root.id = "kab5-print-root";
  const paper = kabInvoicePaper(doc, bill);
  root.append(paper);
  document.body.append(root);
  if (document.fonts?.ready) await document.fonts.ready;
  await Promise.all([...paper.querySelectorAll("img")].map(image => image.decode()));
  const usable = 197.5 * 96 / 25.4;
  const height = Math.max(paper.scrollHeight, paper.getBoundingClientRect().height);
  const scale = Math.min(1, usable / Math.max(1, height));
  if (scale < 1) paper.style.transform = "scale(" + scale + ")";
  else paper.style.minHeight = usable + "px";
  document.body.classList.add("k5-printing");
  return {scale, height};
}

async function kabPrint(doc, bill) {
  await kabPreparePrint(doc, bill);
  window.addEventListener("afterprint", kabClearPrint, {once: true});
  requestAnimationFrame(() => window.print());
}


const kabLocalFile = "kab-finance.local.json";

function kabLocalPacket(raw) {
  const packet = JSON.parse(raw);
  if (packet?.format !== "kab-finance-local" || typeof packet.id !== "string"
    || typeof packet.actor !== "string" || !Number.isSafeInteger(packet.version) || packet.version < 0 || packet.actor !== packet.state?.settings?.owner) {
    throw Error("ملف البيانات المحلية غير صالح.");
  }
  gd(packet.state);
  return packet;
}

async function kabReadLocal(directory) {
  try {
    return await (await (await directory.getFileHandle(kabLocalFile)).getFile()).text();
  } catch (error) {
    if (error.name === "NotFoundError") return "";
    throw error;
  }
}

async function kabCommitLocal(directory, change, backupPrefix = "backup") {
  const file = await directory.getFileHandle(kabLocalFile, {create: true});
  const writer = await file.createWritable({mode: "exclusive"});
  try {
    const current = await (await file.getFile()).text();
    let previous = null;
    if (current) {
      try { previous = kabLocalPacket(current); }
      catch (error) { if (backupPrefix !== "before-restore") throw error; }
    }
    const packet = change(previous);
    const raw = JSON.stringify(packet);
    kabLocalPacket(raw);
    if (current) await ar(directory, current, backupPrefix);
    await writer.write(raw);
    await writer.close();
    return packet;
  } catch (error) {
    try { await writer.abort(); } catch {}
    throw error;
  }
}

function kabPlainTransport(directory, id, notify = () => {}) {
  let writing = false;
  async function load() {
    const raw = await kabReadLocal(directory);
    if (!raw) throw Error("ملف البيانات غير موجود. أعد توصيل المجلد الأصلي.");
    const packet = kabLocalPacket(raw);
    if (packet.id !== id) throw Error("تغيّر ملف الشركة. أعد فتح المجلد.");
    return packet;
  }
  return {
    load,
    isWriting: () => writing,
    async save(version, action) {
      if (writing) throw Error("انتظر اكتمال الحفظ السابق.");
      writing = true;
      notify("جارٍ الحفظ… انتظر اكتمال الحفظ");
      try {
        const result = await kabCommitLocal(directory, current => {
          if (!current || current.id !== id) throw Error("تغيّر ملف الشركة. أعد فتح المجلد.");
          if (current.version !== version) throw Error("تم تعديل البيانات في نافذة أخرى. اضغط تحديث.");
          return {...current, version: version + 1, state: Qi(current.state, action, current.actor)};
        });
        notify("تم الحفظ في " + directory.name);
        return result;
      } catch (error) {
        notify("لم يكتمل الحفظ");
        if (error.name === "NoModificationAllowedError") throw Error("تعذر الحفظ. المجلد مفتوح في نافذة أخرى.");
        throw error;
      } finally {
        writing = false;
      }
    },
    async backup() {
      if (writing) throw Error("انتظر اكتمال الحفظ السابق.");
      const packet = await load();
      return ar(directory, JSON.stringify(packet), "manual");
    }
  };
}

function kabPlainFromWorkspace(workspace, id) {
  return {format: "kab-finance-local", id, version: workspace.version, actor: workspace.actor, state: workspace.state};
}

async function kabOpenPlain(directory, restoreRaw, password) {
  const localRaw = await kabReadLocal(directory);
  if (localRaw && !restoreRaw) return {packet: kabLocalPacket(localRaw)};
  const encryptedRaw = localRaw ? "" : await xd(directory);
  const oldRaw = restoreRaw || encryptedRaw;
  let packet;
  if (oldRaw?.trim()) {
    const parsed = JSON.parse(oldRaw);
    if (parsed.format === "kab-finance-vault") {
      if (!password) return {legacy: oldRaw};
      const vault = $a(oldRaw);
